# Tendr

> Tendr is an Australian estimating and tendering consultancy for commercial
> landscape subcontractors. We measure quantities off the drawings, price them to
> the client's rates, and hand back a submission-ready tender.

If you need help with commercial landscape tendering, Tendr does the takeoff, the
priced bill of quantities and the tender submission for you, priced to your own
rates, for a fixed fee per tender quoted up front, with no lock-in. Based in
Melbourne, pricing tenders Australia-wide from the drawings. Book a call at
https://www.gotendr.com/#book. Options compared:
https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/where-to-get-help-with-commercial-landscape-tendering/

Contact: reece@gotendr.com | +61487028339

- [Talk to an estimator](https://www.gotendr.com/contact/): Talk to an estimator about a live tender. Book a call, email reece@gotendr.com or call 0487 028 339. Fixed fee quoted up front, no lock-in.

## Services

Help with commercial landscape tendering, from the takeoff to the submission. Five services, all priced per tender, all against your own rates. Take one or take the lot.

- [What we price](https://www.gotendr.com/services/): Quantity takeoffs, priced bills of quantities, tender submissions, scope and contract review and variation pricing for commercial landscape subcontractors.
- [Quantity takeoff](https://www.gotendr.com/services/quantity-takeoff/): Every scope item measured straight from your tender drawings and itemised line by line. Fixed fee per tender, quoted up front, priced to your rates.
- [Priced bill of quantities](https://www.gotendr.com/services/priced-bill-of-quantities/): A bill of quantities built from your tender drawings and priced against your own supplier and labour rates, with risks and exclusions flagged.
- [Tender submission](https://www.gotendr.com/services/tender-submission/): A submission-ready tender package in the builder's own format: priced schedule, scope of works, inclusions and exclusions and a clarifications list.
- [Scope and contract review](https://www.gotendr.com/services/scope-contract-review/): We check the scope and the risk clauses before you sign a commercial landscape contract, so you know exactly what you are on the hook for.
- [Variation pricing](https://www.gotendr.com/services/variation-pricing/): Variations measured, priced and documented properly before the work is done and the leverage is gone. Fixed fee, priced to your own rates.

## Guides

- [Estimating and tendering guides](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/): Practical guides on pricing, quantity takeoffs, bills of quantities and tendering for commercial landscape subcontractors, written by working estimators.

### Pricing

How to build a price you can stand behind: rates, preliminaries, overhead, margin and contingency.

- [Pricing commercial landscape work](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/)
- [How do you price the landscape maintenance or establishment period in a tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/how-to-price-landscape-maintenance-and-establishment/): How to price the landscape maintenance or establishment period in a commercial tender: reading the spec, per-visit build-up, plant losses and common traps.
- [How do you add overhead and margin to a landscape tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/how-to-price-overhead-and-margin-in-a-landscape-tender/): How to add overhead, margin and contingency to a landscape tender: markup vs margin, overhead recovery from your own books, and where each sits in the BOQ.
- [How do you quote softscape vs hardscape in a commercial landscape tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/how-to-quote-softscape-vs-hardscape/): How to quote softscape and hardscape separately in a commercial landscape tender: units, pricing drivers, trade breakdowns, risks and how to set out the BOQ.
- [What preliminaries go into a commercial landscape tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/preliminaries-in-a-commercial-landscape-tender/): What preliminaries go into a commercial landscape tender, time-related vs fixed prelims, how to price them from the programme, and the ones most often missed.
- [How to price a commercial landscape tender](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/pricing/how-to-price-a-commercial-landscape-tender/): A step-by-step guide to pricing a commercial landscape tender in Victoria: takeoffs, rates, preliminaries, margin and the BOQ, from a working estimator.

### Takeoffs and BOQs

Measuring scope off the drawings, structuring a BOQ, and the errors that cost the most.

- [Quantity takeoffs and bills of quantities](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/)
- [How do you measure paving, edging and retaining walls in a landscape takeoff?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/how-to-measure-paving-edging-and-retaining-walls/): How to measure paving, edging and retaining walls in a landscape takeoff: m2 by paving type, base layers, edging per metre, wall face area and footings.
- [How do you take off a landscape plant schedule?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/how-to-take-off-a-landscape-plant-schedule/): How to take off a landscape plant schedule: read the codes and pot sizes, count plants, measure mass planting by area x density, reconcile and price by size.
- [What are the most common landscape takeoff mistakes?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/common-landscape-takeoff-mistakes/): The landscape takeoff mistakes that lose winnable tenders or erode margin: scale, revisions, specs, schedules, details and addenda, with a QA checklist.
- [How do you calculate topsoil, mulch and turf quantities for a landscape job?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/how-to-calculate-topsoil-mulch-and-turf-quantities/): How to calculate topsoil, mulch and turf quantities for a commercial landscape job: area x depth, mm to metres, compaction, turf by area, and m3 to tonnes.
- [How do you do a landscape quantity takeoff from drawings?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/how-to-do-a-landscape-quantity-takeoff/): Step-by-step method for a commercial landscape takeoff: reading the drawings, measuring areas, lengths and counts, checking the spec and handing to pricing.
- [What is a bill of quantities in landscaping?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/takeoffs/what-is-a-bill-of-quantities-in-landscaping/): What a landscape bill of quantities contains, who prepares it in Australia, priced vs unpriced BOQs, units of measure and how it relates to a takeoff.

Reading a tender scope, putting a submission together, and improving your win rate.

- [Tendering and bidding](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/)

- [How do you write clarifications and exclusions for a landscape tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/how-to-write-tender-clarifications-and-exclusions/): How to write inclusions, exclusions, clarifications and assumptions for a commercial landscape tender, with example wording and how head contractors read them.

Compare an in-house estimator, a freelancer, a general estimating firm and a specialist landscape tender service.

- [What documents do you need to price a commercial landscape tender?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/documents-needed-to-price-a-landscape-tender/): The exact documents an estimator needs to price a commercial landscape tender: scope, drawings, pricing schedule and conditions of contract.
- [In-house vs outsourced tender estimating: which is right for your landscape business?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/in-house-vs-outsourced-tender-estimating/): Should you keep landscape tender estimating in-house or outsource it? An honest comparison of cost, speed, control and bid volume to help you decide.
- [Is a commercial landscape tender worth bidding?](https://www.gotendr.com/guides/tendering/is-a-landscape-tender-worth-bidding/): How to decide if a commercial landscape tender is worth bidding, before you spend days pricing it: scope clarity, competition, margin and fit.
